_note: Synthetic 300-tick PushT-like episode for the lictor-fuse pass-through tests (no simulator involved).
Planned path p(t): x drifts +2 px/step from 194.5, ramps to 25 px/step over t=89..96 to reach 490 at t=96,
rests at 490 for t=97..119, drifts back -2 px/step to 328 at t=200, then STALLS (constant) to t=299;
y = 300 + 60 sin(2 pi u/120) on a clock u that pauses over the rest and the stall. Box hi = 495 (497-2).
obs.vel = backward difference (p(t)-p(t-1))/0.1, zero at t=0; aux/ext are constant filler.
Chunk k (t_emit = 8k, 15 x 2, exec 8): row i = p(t_emit + i + 1), except the rogue chunks:
chunk 5 (t=40): y rows climb 10 px/step from y(40); row 14 lands ~7 px outside the box -> WORKSPACE only
(brake-feasible, clampable): Clamped in both modes, cleared after clear_ticks = 5 clean ticks.
chunk 12 (t=96): x rows 520..940 from pos x=490 at 250 px/s toward the wall; the projection parks the rows
at 495 and the PD rollout overshoots by ~4.1 px -> WORKSPACE + BRAKE: Braking in both modes.
chunk 13 (t=104): x rows 500 from rest at 490 -> WORKSPACE only, brake-feasible (no overshoot from rest).
chunks 25..37 (t>=200): the frozen policy commands p(200) on every row (the stall).
The recorded positions stay inside the box even where Observe mode would have let the rogue rows through:
the fixture is open-loop data, not a simulation.
